tfbind8.notes: Canonical publication-ready expansion of the BAR15A SIX6_REF_R1 reverse-complement table; exactly 65,536 unique 8-mers.

tfbind10.original_repository: Design-Bench TFBind10 Pho4 landscape; corrected exhaustive release in DiBO
tfbind10.notes: TFBind10-Exact-v0 is a complete 4^10 (=1,048,576) Pho4 DNA landscape. The released target is negative binding free-energy difference (-ddG), so larger label values mean stronger binding.

gb1.original_repository: Associated eLife source data; standardized full landscape distributed by FLIP

gfp.notes: Audited sequence reconstruction from Sarkisyan genotypes.

utr5_mpra.paper: Sample et al., Nature Biotechnology 2019, doi:10.1038/s41587-019-0164-5
utr5_mpra.notes: Canonical training data are the original GSM3130435 egfp_unmod_1 table. Sort by total_reads stably, retain 280,000, use ranks 1–20,000 as test and 20,001–280,000 as train, exactly as the authors' training_MRL_CNN.ipynb. The 50-nt canonical sequence excludes the fixed 25-nt reporter prefix.

igvf_ccre_mpra.paper: Kircher et al., MPRAsnakeflow, Genome Biology 2025
manual_steps: Open https://data.igvf.org and search each portal accession listed in sources.json.
Download the processed element-activity table and the matching oligo design/sequence file (not FASTQ unless reprocessing counts).
Join on element/oligo identifier and provide columns sequence, cell_type, activity to the IGVF loader.

deepstarr.paper: de Almeida et al., Nature Genetics 2022, doi:10.1038/s41588-022-01048-5
deepstarr.notes: Compressed Parquet mirror of the original Zenodo Train/Val/Test FASTA and activity files; original split is preserved.

agarwal2025_lentimpra.original_repository: PMC11903340 Supplementary Table package; ENCODE lentiMPRA experiments
agarwal2025_lentimpra.notes: The PMC supplementary package contains Table S3 (large-library sequence design), Table S4 (large-library activity), Table S10 (joint-library sequence design), and Table S11 (joint-library activity). Activity is log2-normalized RNA/DNA. ENCODE accessions: pilots ENCSR463IRX/ENCSR460LZI; large-scale ENCSR022GQD/ENCSR382BVV/ENCSR244FWB; joint ENCSR405QCT/ENCSR203UFY/ENCSR336MKI.

cetnar2024_mrna_stability.paper: Cetnar et al., Nature Communications 2024, doi:10.1038/s41467-024-54059-7
cetnar2024_mrna_stability.notes: 62,120 barcoded E. coli synthetic 5-prime UTR designs. The standardized release retains the 57,780 rows with a positive fitted kinetic degradation rate (k_fit), and represents the assayed RNA sequence with U rather than the DNA-library T.

kosuri2013_composability.original_repository: PNAS / PMC supplementary materials for PMC3752251
kosuri2013_composability.notes: Combinatorial E. coli promoter--RBS library. Dataset S3 contains per-construct DNA, RNA, and protein measurements; S1 and S2 contain the promoter and RBS sequence tables. The local raw-data directory may contain user-supplied copies named sd01.xls, sd02.xls, and sd03.xls.

files.description: Dataset S1: promoter identities, sequences, and aggregate measurements
Dataset S2: RBS identities, sequences, and aggregate measurements
Dataset S3: per promoter--RBS construct intermediate and final values

manual_steps: Download the three named XLS files from the Supplementary Materials section of the PMC article in a web browser if they are not already present.
Put them in BioSeqBench/raw_data/kosuri2013_composability/ as sd01.xls, sd02.xls, and sd03.xls (symlinks are supported).
The framework will validate the workbook columns before generating paired promoter--RBS RNA and protein targets.

openvaccine.paper: Wayment-Steele et al., Nature Machine Intelligence 2022, doi:10.1038/s42256-022-00571-8
openvaccine.original_repository: Stanford OpenVaccine Kaggle challenge; author-maintained GitHub copy

zhao2022_ptrc_promoters.paper: Zhao et al., ACS Synthetic Biology 2022, doi:10.1021/acssynbio.1c00117
zhao2022_ptrc_promoters.notes: The empirical benchmark joins 3,665 fluorescence/OD600 measurements (ML<n>) to their 3,665 DNA sequences (PL<n>). The 390,625 combinatorial sequence sheet is deliberately excluded because it has no experimental activity label.

zhou2026_l3_promoters.paper: Zhou et al., ACS Synthetic Biology 2026, doi:10.1021/acssynbio.5c00765
zhou2026_l3_promoters.notes: L3 processed FACS-seq promoter sequence/strength table (20,799 entries).

yeast_gpra_vaishnav2022.notes: Two deposited GPRA training libraries are standardized as separate condition-specific tasks: complex glucose and defined SC-Ura.

parm_gse301246.notes: Normalized BED files contain hg19 coordinates and Log2RPM labels. The streaming converter reconstructs the exact strand-aware DNA sequences from hg19 and preserves the published folds.
